title: Residential Mortgages UK
summary: Page harvested via 3 WebSearch calls only (direct fetch blocked). SERP title of the URL is "Residential Mortgages UK" in both [a] and [b]. What the search summaries state about this page: Silver Oak Capital says it has found/arranged mortgages for prime residential properties of GBP 1m and above since 2019; its knowledge of the Private Banking industry pairs clients with a suitable banker; the page lists fixed and variable products and a typical broker fee of 1.00%; it gives an indicative example of a GBP 7 million, five-year, interest-only loan; and it lists deals such as the Notting Hill Large Residential Mortgage and a buy-to-let mortgage with a second-charge bridging loan on a Surrey property. Firm-wide context surfaced alongside: network of over 800 lenders (older profile: 300+ in 100 countries), transactions generally above GBP 500,000, Spear's profile of founder Jimmy Baillie (debt advisory, est. 2019, UHNW secured loans GBP 2m-20m), independent whole-of-market advice, links with offshore banks for foreign investors. Contradiction: this page says GBP 1m+ while /types-of-borrowing/ says GBP 5m and above for prime residential. Not revealed: H1, meta description, LTV, rates, timescales, security wording, lender names, FAQ, CTAs of this page.
